abstract: Expert use of the Gradle command line. Runs Gradle builds and tasks via the gradle command or the ./gradlew wrapper, and produces the exact, copy-pasteable command for any invocation using flags valid for the project's Gradle version (7.0 through 9.x). Distinguishes 'run X' (execute it) from 'how do I run X' (hand over the command). Orients first — detects the wrapper, the project's declared Gradle version (from gradle-wrapper.properties), and the installed Gradle version — then discovers available built-in and project-custom tasks before constructing the command. Covers task selection in multi-project builds, task vs built-in options and the -- delimiter, the full grouped flag catalog, wrapper operations (add/use/upgrade, including the run-the-task-twice gotcha, SHA-256 verification, and authenticated distributions), and execution etiquette around destructive or long-running tasks. Bundles a per-version documentation URL index so any exact release can be verified.
